responsibility: This file implements GCC’s generic lazy code motion engine on CFG edge bitmaps, providing the core dataflow algorithms used by RTL optimization passes that can be modeled as partial redundancy elimination problems. It computes anticipatability, availability, earliest/later or farthest/nearer placement sets, and finally insertion and deletion maps over an edge_list from per-block TRANSP/AVLOC/ANTLOC/KILL bitmaps, exposing forward and reverse edge-based LCM entry points such as pre_edge_lcm and pre_edge_rev_lcm. Its role is algorithmic infrastructure for placement of computations, loads/stores, saves/restores, and related motions rather than a pass for any single optimization.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/lcm.h, which only declares the lazy code motion entry points, this .cc file contains the dataflow solver implementations that compute anticipatability, availability, placement, and insert/delete sets over CFG edges.
